observations.observation: Read all2134 characters. An attributed dam-risk warning motivates a three-option choice; AHP reduces criteria to cost/benefit and chooses option3. That choice becomes the input to the next deliverable, number/location of replacement dams, framed as multiobjective coverage and demand evaluation before a genetic search produces an approximate12-dam solution. A joint-operation stage then turns four climate-year categories into monthly modulation. Sensitivity distinguishes outputs: locations shift slightly while the dam count holds, and changing one output coefficient has little effect on two stated operating indices. The organization is decision-to-design-to-operation, with explicit dependencies rather than disconnected methods. The warning's population/risk claim and the stated robustness are source assertions, not independently verified facts or model correctness. There are no sensitivity magnitudes or guarantee of a global optimum in this abstract; preserve 'approximate'. Competition banner remains candidate metadata requiring source classification. No source-fidelity promotion.
